statements.anchor:
may not access
reference materials, the Internet, generative AI tools, or communicate with others during the quiz
statements.why: A prohibition on accessing generative AI (among other resources) during quizzes, addressed to students.
statements.label: no AI during quizzes

statements.anchor:
must be done individually, potentially with the assistance
from Generative AI tools.
statements.why: Work is individual but generative AI assistance is allowed as a possibility, so a permission.
statements.label: AI assistance allowed on individual work

statements.anchor:
Students may use online resources and Generative AI tools
to work on the assignments
statements.why: Explicit permission to use generative AI on assignments.
statements.label: AI allowed on assignments

statements.anchor:
they must demonstrate their progress
to the teaching staff at the conclusion of the assignment.
statements.why: A condition requiring students to demonstrate progress to staff after the assignment.
statements.label: must demonstrate progress to staff

statements.anchor:
Students
will be assessed upon the progress they make, their demonstration of
learning outcome attainment, and effective collaboration.
statements.why: Describes the assessment basis, which is progress and learning outcomes rather than the product.
statements.label: graded on progress not product

statements.anchor:
students may not submit work that has been
generated by automated programming or text generation tools
(such as Copilot or ChatGPT) on quizzes.
statements.why: Prohibits submitting AI-generated work on quizzes, naming code tools like Copilot.
statements.label: no AI-generated work on quizzes

statements.anchor:
You are not permitted to use generative AI tools for any work for this section
of this course.
statements.why: Blanket ban on generative AI for all course work.
statements.label: AI banned for all work

statements.anchor:
This includes the use of popular tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney,
GitHub Co-Pilot
statements.why: Clarifies the scope of the ban by naming specific tools including a coding assistant.
statements.label: ban covers named AI tools

statements.anchor:
the professor can only fairly and accurately
evaluate work that is not assisted by generative AI.
statements.why: Gives the reason for the ban: fair evaluation of student work.
statements.label: ban justified by fair evaluation

statements.anchor:
Use of generative AI for
assigned work in this course will be considered a violation of the university's
academic integrity policies.
statements.why: States the consequence: AI use is treated as an academic integrity violation.
statements.label: AI use is integrity violation

statements.anchor:
If you have any questions about whether or not use
of a particular tool or technology is allowed, check with your instructor first.
statements.why: A procedure for uncertain cases: ask the instructor before using a tool.
statements.label: ask instructor if tool unclear
